title: Session workflow tooling fix set: node-kind taxonomy, enum schema/contract, catalog, inline handle
detail: Covers: behavioral (ticket/validation/spec) vs descriptive (task/category) node kinds with back-compat aliasing and symmetric required-Spec finish gating; MCP schema advertises workflow enums; parse rejections enumerate allowed values; session_capabilities catalog lists lifecycle + enums; workspace_session_id echoed top-line by init/resume and every workflow/runtime tool. Prompt-replay of the 367ac6a3 runtime_init -> workflow_add_node flow is covered by runtime_init_result_exposes_workspace_session_id_top_line.
